title: Vibrant Snappy Kenyan Yang Bowl
description: A fermented and snappy Kenyan dish featuring tamarind paste and char-grilled yang, served in an earthenware bowl, this recipe is ayurvedic rajasic friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and brush the yang with coconut oil.
Season the yang with salt, black pepper, and ayurvedic spices.
Grill the yang for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it is char-grilled and cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together the tamarind paste and 2 tablespoons of water.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, fermented vegetables, and char-grilled yang.
Drizzle the tamarind paste mixture over the top of the yang bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as cilantro or parsley, if desired.
Serve the vibrant snappy Kenyan yang bowl in the earthenware bowl and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
